events.facts: Jupiter turns retrograde in Leo around 13 December 2026 and stays retrograde until about 12 April 2027. Retrograde means the planet seems to move backwards when seen from Earth; in astrology it is read as a time to review, not to rush. Jupiter is the planet of growth, luck and confidence; Leo is about heart, creativity, pride and being seen.

On 21 December 2026 the Sun enters Capricorn at the December solstice: the start of summer in the Southern Hemisphere (Brazil) and of winter in the Northern Hemisphere. Capricorn season is read as a time of discipline, long-term goals, responsibility and building step by step.
